query:
SELECT
                COALESCE(l.level, 0) AS "level!: i32",
                COALESCE(m.prestige, 0) AS "prestige!: i64"
            FROM
                (SELECT $1::BIGINT AS user_id) u
            LEFT JOIN
                levels l ON l.user_id = u.user_id
            LEFT JOIN
                gambling_mine m ON m.user_id = u.user_id
